---
title: "Routes"
subtitle: "From the Park Centre, Cleveland Trail at W 16th Ave"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@5.24.0/dist/maplibre-gl.css">
---

Pick a distance and a route type. Everyone who opens this page on the same
day, with the same choices, gets the same route of the day; **Another route**
shuffles. Routes stay on park trails as much as possible and use streets only
to link trails up.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Two-thumb distance slider: its value is [low, high] in km.
function rangeSlider({min, max, step, value, label}) {
  const form = html`<form class="range2">
    <label>${label}</label>
    <div class="range2-track">
      <input type="range" name="lo" min=${min} max=${max} step=${step} value=${value[0]} aria-label="Shortest">
      <input type="range" name="hi" min=${min} max=${max} step=${step} value=${value[1]} aria-label="Longest">
    </div>
    <output name="out"></output>
  </form>`;
  const {lo, hi, out} = form.elements;
  const track = form.querySelector(".range2-track");
  const pct = (v) => `${(100 * (v - min)) / (max - min)}%`;
  const update = () => {
    form.value = [+lo.value, +hi.value];
    out.value = `${lo.value}–${hi.value} km`;
    track.style.setProperty("--lo", pct(lo.value));
    track.style.setProperty("--hi", pct(hi.value));
  };
  form.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
    // Thumbs can't pass each other.
    if (+lo.value > +hi.value) {
      if (event.target === lo) lo.value = hi.value;
      else hi.value = lo.value;
    }
    update();
  });
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => event.preventDefault());
  update();
  return form;
}

DEFAULT_TYPES = ["Loop"]
DEFAULT_KM = [7, 10]

viewof types = Inputs.checkbox(["Loop", "Out-and-back"], {
  label: "Route type",
  value: DEFAULT_TYPES
})
viewof km = rangeSlider({min: 4, max: 12, step: 0.5, value: DEFAULT_KM, label: "Distance"})
viewof again = Inputs.button("Another route")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
routes = FileAttachment("routes.geojson").json()

matching = routes.features.filter(
  (f) =>
    types.map((t) => t.toLowerCase()).includes(f.properties.type) &&
    f.properties.km >= km[0] &&
    f.properties.km <= km[1]
)

// Today in Vancouver, as YYYY-MM-DD: the seed for the route of the day.
today = new Date().toLocaleDateString("en-CA", {timeZone: "America/Vancouver"})

// FNV-1a string hash: turns the date into a number, the same on every phone.
function hash(text) {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (const c of text) h = Math.imul(h ^ c.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
  return h >>> 0;
}

// mulberry32: random numbers from a seed. Same seed, same sequence, anywhere.
function seeded(seed) {
  return () => {
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

// Today's order for the matching routes: a Fisher-Yates shuffle seeded by the
// date. Everyone gets the same order; "Another route" steps along it, so no
// route repeats until you've seen them all.
order = {
  const random = seeded(hash(today));
  const idx = matching.map((_, i) => i);
  for (let i = idx.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
    [idx[i], idx[j]] = [idx[j], idx[i]];
  }
  return idx;
}

// A shared link (…/routes.html?route=<key>) shows that route until you
// change a setting or ask for another.
sharedKey = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("route")
sharedRoute = routes.features.find((f) => f.properties.key === sharedKey) ?? null
useShared =
  sharedRoute !== null &&
  again === 0 &&
  types.join() === DEFAULT_TYPES.join() &&
  km.join() === DEFAULT_KM.join()

position = matching.length ? again % matching.length : 0

route = useShared
  ? sharedRoute
  : matching.length
    ? matching[order[position]]
    : null
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
route
  ? html`<div class="route-card">
      <h3>${route.properties.name}</h3>
      <p class="route-stats">
        <strong>${route.properties.km.toFixed(1)} km</strong> ${route.properties.type} ·
        <strong>↑ ${route.properties.gain_m} m ↓ ${route.properties.loss_m} m</strong> ·
        ${route.properties.trail_pct}% trail · ${route.properties.street_pct}% street
        <span class="route-id">· route ${route.properties.id} ·
        ${useShared
          ? "shared with you"
          : `${again === 0 ? "route of the day" : "another route"}: ${position + 1} of ${matching.length} matching routes`}</span>
      </p>
      ${sharedKey && !sharedRoute
        ? html`<p class="route-note">The shared route isn't in the current list
            (routes are rebuilt when the trail data changes), so here's today's route.</p>`
        : ""}
    </div>`
  : html`<p><em>No routes match. Widen the distance or tick another route type.</em></p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
maplibregl = require("maplibre-gl@5.24.0/dist/maplibre-gl.js")

START = [-123.22248, 49.25918] // Park Centre
EMPTY = ({type: "FeatureCollection", features: []})

map = {
  const m = new maplibregl.Map({
    container: mapDiv,
    style: "https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/positron",
    center: START,
    zoom: 13.5,
    attributionControl: {
      customAttribution: "Trails © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)"
    }
  });
  m.addControl(new maplibregl.NavigationControl(), "top-right");
  await new Promise((resolve) => m.on("load", resolve));
  m.addSource("route", {type: "geojson", data: EMPTY});
  m.addSource("hover", {type: "geojson", data: EMPTY});
  const round = {"line-join": "round", "line-cap": "round"};
  m.addLayer({id: "route-casing", type: "line", source: "route", layout: round,
              paint: {"line-color": "#fcfcfb", "line-width": 8}});
  m.addLayer({id: "route", type: "line", source: "route", layout: round,
              paint: {"line-color": "#2a78d6", "line-width": 4}});
  // Arrows along the line show which way to run.
  m.addLayer({id: "route-arrows", type: "symbol", source: "route",
              layout: {"symbol-placement": "line", "symbol-spacing": 80,
                       "text-field": "›", "text-font": ["Noto Sans Bold"],
                       "text-size": 22, "text-keep-upright": false,
                       "text-allow-overlap": true},
              paint: {"text-color": "#0b0b0b"}});
  // Where the pointer is on the elevation profile.
  m.addLayer({id: "hover", type: "circle", source: "hover",
              paint: {"circle-radius": 7, "circle-color": "#eb6834",
                      "circle-stroke-color": "#fcfcfb", "circle-stroke-width": 2}});
  new maplibregl.Marker({color: "#0b0b0b"})
    .setLngLat(START)
    .setPopup(new maplibregl.Popup().setText("Start and finish: Park Centre"))
    .addTo(m);
  invalidation.then(() => m.remove());
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function gpx(f) {
  const points = f.geometry.coordinates
    .map(([lon, lat]) => `<trkpt lat="${lat}" lon="${lon}"></trkpt>`)
    .join("\n      ");
  return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx version="1.1" creator="psp-trails" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1">
  <trk>
    <name>PSP ${f.properties.id}: ${f.properties.name} (${f.properties.km} km)</name>
    <trkseg>
      ${points}
    </trkseg>
  </trk>
</gpx>`;
}

// Share: the phone's share sheet (messages, WhatsApp, email, Strava, ...).
// The text has a link that opens this exact route; the GPX goes along where
// the phone allows files. With no share sheet, the text goes to the clipboard.
function shareRoute(f) {
  const p = f.properties;
  const link = `${location.origin}${location.pathname}?route=${p.key}`;
  const text = [
    `${p.name}: ${p.km.toFixed(1)} km ${p.type}, ↑${p.gain_m} m ↓${p.loss_m} m,`,
    "from the Park Centre (Cleveland Trail & W 16th Ave)",
    link,
    "",
    ...p.directions.map(([at, full]) => `${at.toFixed(1)} km  ${full}`)
  ].join("\n");
  const title = `Pacific Spirit run: ${p.name}`;
  const file = new File([gpx(f)], `psp-${p.id}.gpx`, {type: "application/gpx+xml"});
  const quietly = (e) => { if (e.name !== "AbortError") throw e; }; // user cancelled
  if (navigator.canShare?.({files: [file]})) {
    return navigator.share({title, text, files: [file]}).catch(quietly);
  }
  if (navigator.share) return navigator.share({title, text}).catch(quietly);
  return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => "copied");
}

function shareButton(f) {
  const button = html`<button class="btn btn-quarto" type="button">Share</button>`;
  button.onclick = async () => {
    if ((await shareRoute(f)) === "copied") {
      button.textContent = "Copied ✓";
      setTimeout(() => (button.textContent = "Share"), 2000);
    }
  };
  return button;
}

route
  ? html`<div class="route-actions">
      ${DOM.download(
        () => new Blob([gpx(route)], {type: "application/gpx+xml"}),
        `psp-${route.properties.id}.gpx`,
        "Download GPX"
      )}
      ${shareButton(route)}
    </div>`
  : html``
```

### Printable card

For runners who'd rather leave the phone at home: the route's outline and
every turn with the km it comes at. Pick a card size, print, and cut along
the dashed lines. The preview is the real printed size; the text shrinks
until the whole route fits.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Card sizes: a US Letter page (8.5 × 11 in, 0.3 in margins) cut into a grid.
// `font` is where the text size starts; it shrinks until the route fits.
LAYOUTS = [
  {n: 2, cols: 1, rows: 2, font: 13, size: "7.9 × 5.2 in"},
  {n: 4, cols: 2, rows: 2, font: 10, size: "3.9 × 5.2 in"},
  {n: 8, cols: 2, rows: 4, font: 8, size: "3.9 × 2.6 in, palm size"},
  {n: 10, cols: 2, rows: 5, font: 8, size: "3.9 × 2.1 in, business card"},
  {n: 12, cols: 3, rows: 4, font: 8, size: "2.6 × 2.6 in, sticky note"}
].map((l) => ({...l, w: 7.9 / l.cols, h: 10.4 / l.rows, compact: l.n >= 8}))

// Buttons, not a dropdown: always visible, and no oversized native menu.
viewof layout = Inputs.radio(LAYOUTS, {
  label: "Cards per page",
  format: (l) => String(l.n),
  value: LAYOUTS[2]
})

html`<p class="layout-size">Each card ${layout.size}</p>`

route
  ? html`<div class="route-actions">
      ${Inputs.button("Print cards", {reduce: () => printCards(route, layout)})}
    </div>`
  : html``
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// A card, as HTML text, so the same markup serves the preview and the print page.
function esc(text) {
  return String(text).replace(/[&<>"]/g, (c) => ({"&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;"})[c]);
}

function outline(f, size) {
  // Route shape, north up, scaled to fit a square.
  const pts = f.geometry.coordinates;
  const k = Math.cos((pts[0][1] * Math.PI) / 180);
  const xs = pts.map(([lon]) => lon * k), ys = pts.map(([, lat]) => lat);
  const [x0, x1, y0, y1] = [Math.min(...xs), Math.max(...xs), Math.min(...ys), Math.max(...ys)];
  const scale = (size - 12) / Math.max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0);
  const dx = (size - (x1 - x0) * scale) / 2, dy = (size - (y1 - y0) * scale) / 2;
  const P = pts.map((_, i) => [dx + (xs[i] - x0) * scale, size - dy - (ys[i] - y0) * scale]);
  const line = P.map(([x, y]) => `${x.toFixed(1)},${y.toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");
  const i = Math.floor(P.length * 0.08); // an arrow early on shows the direction
  const [ax, ay] = P[i], [bx, by] = P[Math.min(i + 3, P.length - 1)];
  const angle = (Math.atan2(by - ay, bx - ax) * 180) / Math.PI;
  return `<svg class="pc-outline" viewBox="0 0 ${size} ${size}" width="${size}" height="${size}">
    <polyline points="${line}" fill="none" stroke="#0b0b0b" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M -5 -4 L 4 0 L -5 4 z" fill="#0b0b0b" transform="translate(${bx.toFixed(1)} ${by.toFixed(1)}) rotate(${angle.toFixed(0)})"/>
    <circle cx="${P[0][0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${P[0][1].toFixed(1)}" r="4" fill="#fff" stroke="#0b0b0b" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="${size - 2}" y="10" text-anchor="end" font-size="9" font-weight="700">N↑</text>
  </svg>`;
}

function cardHtml(f, layout) {
  const p = f.properties;
  const steps = p.directions
    .map(([at, , short]) => `<li><b>${at.toFixed(1)}</b> ${esc(short)}</li>`)
    .join("");
  const stats = `${p.km.toFixed(1)} km ${esc(p.type)} · ↑${p.gain_m} ↓${p.loss_m} m`;
  if (layout.compact) {
    // Directions get the full height; outline, start and legend sit at the side.
    const columns = layout.n === 10 ? 3 : 2; // short, wide cards: three columns
    return `<div class="pc pc-compact">
      <div class="pc-head"><span class="pc-name">${esc(p.name)}</span><span class="pc-stats">${stats}</span></div>
      <ol class="pc-steps" style="columns: ${columns}">${steps}</ol>
      <div class="pc-side">${outline(f, 58)}
        <div>○ Park Centre</div>
        <div class="pc-legend">←→ turn<br>↖↗ slight<br>T T-junction<br>Y fork<br>↑ straight<br>WC toilets</div>
        <div>${esc(p.id)}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
  return `<div class="pc">
    <div class="pc-head">
      <div class="pc-name">${esc(p.name)}</div>
      <div class="pc-stats">${stats} · ${p.trail_pct}% trail</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pc-body">
      <div class="pc-side">${outline(f, 110)}<div class="pc-start">○ Park Centre<br>Cleveland &amp; W 16th</div></div>
      <ol class="pc-steps">${steps}</ol>
    </div>
    <div class="pc-foot">
      <span>← → turn · ↖↗ slight · ↙↘ sharp · T T-junction · Y fork · ↑ straight · WC toilets</span>
      <span>${esc(p.id)} · pstrunners.github.io</span>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

CARD_CSS = `
.pc { box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px dashed #898781; padding: 0.1in 0.12in;
      font: 9pt/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; color: #0b0b0b;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; }
.pc-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px;
           border-bottom: 1px solid #0b0b0b; padding-bottom: 3px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.pc-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.15em; }
.pc-stats { white-space: nowrap; }
.pc-body { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex: 1; min-height: 0; }
.pc-side { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 0.8em; color: #52514e; }
.pc-steps { margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; columns: 2; column-gap: 0.8em;
            flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.pc-steps li { break-inside: avoid; padding: 0.5px 0; }
.pc-steps b { display: inline-block; min-width: 2.1em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.pc-foot { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2px 8px;
           font-size: 0.72em; color: #52514e; border-top: 1px solid #c3c2b7;
           padding-top: 2px; margin-top: 3px; }
.pc-foot span:last-child { white-space: nowrap; }
.pc-compact { padding: 0.07in 0.09in; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
              grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; column-gap: 0.6em; }
.pc-compact .pc-head { grid-column: 1; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 0.6em; margin-bottom: 3px; }
.pc-compact .pc-name { font-size: 1.05em; }
.pc-compact .pc-steps { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
.pc-compact .pc-side { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 0.62in; display: flex;
                       flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; font-size: 0.8em; color: #52514e; }
.pc-compact .pc-outline { width: 0.62in; height: 0.62in; }
.pc-compact .pc-legend { line-height: 1.25; }
`

// Shrink the text until the directions fit on the card (no hidden overflow).
function fitCards(root, start) {
  const cards = [...root.querySelectorAll(".pc")];
  const card = cards[0], steps = card.querySelector(".pc-steps");
  const over = () =>
    card.scrollHeight > card.clientHeight + 1 ||
    steps.scrollHeight > steps.clientHeight + 1 ||
    steps.scrollWidth > steps.clientWidth + 1;
  let size = start;
  const apply = () => cards.forEach((c) => (c.style.fontSize = `${size}pt`));
  apply();
  while (over() && size > 5) {
    size -= 0.25;
    apply();
  }
  return size;
}

function printCards(f, layout) {
  const page = `<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>PSP ${esc(f.properties.id)} cards</title>
    <style>${CARD_CSS}
      @page { size: letter; margin: 0.3in; }
      body { margin: 0; }
      .sheet { display: grid; width: 7.9in;
               grid-template-columns: repeat(${layout.cols}, ${layout.w}in);
               grid-template-rows: repeat(${layout.rows}, ${layout.h}in); }
    </style></head>
    <body><div class="sheet">${cardHtml(f, layout).repeat(layout.n)}</div>
    <script>${fitCards.toString()}
      window.onload = () => { fitCards(document, ${layout.font}); window.print(); };
    <\/script></body></html>`;
  const w = window.open("", "_blank");
  w.document.write(page);
  w.document.close();
}

cardPreview = {
  if (!route) return html``;
  const box = html`<div class="card-preview"><style>${CARD_CSS}</style></div>`;
  box.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", cardHtml(route, layout));
  const card = box.querySelector(".pc");
  card.style.width = `${layout.w}in`;
  card.style.height = `${layout.h}in`;
  yield box; // on the page, so the browser can measure it
  fitCards(box, layout.font);
}
```

### Cue sheet

Every stretch of the route, as mapped: more literal than the directions.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
route
  ? html`<details class="cue-details"><summary>Show every stretch</summary>
      <table class="table table-sm cue-sheet">
        <thead><tr><th>At km</th><th>Follow</th><th>For km</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${route.properties.cues.map(([label, at, len]) =>
          html`<tr><td>${at.toFixed(2)}</td><td>${label}</td><td>${len.toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`
        )}</tbody>
      </table>
    </details>`
  : html``
```

Routes are generated from OpenStreetMap data and our own
[edits](https://github.com/pstrunners/pstrunners.github.io/tree/main/data/manual);
elevation is NRCan lidar. Check trail closures and park rules before you go,
and stay on marked trails.
